A claim ledger table in SQLite with schema:
- entity_key \(canonical key like domain:acme.ai\)
- predicate \(problem_solved, target_customer, business_model, etc.\)
- value \(the claim text\)
- confidence \(0-1\)
- evidence_json \(snippet + source_url + retrieved_at\)
- source_signal_id \(FK to signals table\)
- extractor_version \(for reproducibility\)
- valid_from, valid_to \(temporal validity\)

ProfileBuilder composes current view:
- Takes most recent claim per predicate
- Weighted by source priority \(Companies House > SEC > Crunchbase > GitHub\)
- Flags conflicts when sources disagree

3. How should we handle claim retraction when source data changes?
4. Should claims be immutable \(append-only\) or mutable?

Be specific with concrete implementation concerns." --sandbox read-only)

Add-Type @''
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public class Win32 {
    [DllImport\(""user32.dll""\)]
    public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow\(IntPtr hWnd\);
    [DllImport\(""user32.dll""\)]
    public static extern IntPtr FindWindow\(string lpClassName, string lpWindowName\);
}
''@

# Find and activate browser window \(try common browser classes\)
$browsers = @\(''Chrome_WidgetWin_1'', ''MozillaWindowClass'', ''ApplicationFrameWindow''\)
foreach \($class in $browsers\) {
    $hwnd = [Win32]::FindWindow\($class, $null\)
    if \($hwnd -ne [IntPtr]::Zero\) {
        [Win32]::SetForegroundWindow\($hwnd\)
        Write-Host ""Activated browser window""
        break
    }
}

Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

# Take screenshot
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$screen = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::PrimaryScreen
$bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap\($screen.Bounds.Width, $screen.Bounds.Height\)
$graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage\($bitmap\)
$graphics.CopyFromScreen\($screen.Bounds.Location, [System.Drawing.Point]::Empty, $screen.Bounds.Size\)
$bitmap.Save\(''C:/dev/Harmonic/dashboard_screenshot.png''\)
$graphics.Dispose\(\)
$bitmap.Dispose\(\)
Write-Host ""Screenshot saved""
")
